scenario: Beginner Korean ordering dinner at a restaurant, including choosing a dish, ordering a drink, adjusting an order, and asking for the bill.
audience: English-speaking adults learning practical beginner Korean for travel
level: Beginner: two easy, two medium and two hard questions, with the sixth as the unanswered comment bonus
context: An English-speaking beginner is ordering dinner at a restaurant, making simple choices and polite requests, then paying.
learningObjectives: Order a chosen dinner dish politely.
Request one cup of a specific drink.
Ask for a dish to be made less spicy.
Ask for a particular ingredient to be left out.
Request the bill after finishing dinner.
Ask to pay separately when dining with a friend.
